title: Pat Oleszko Wins $100K Whitney Biennial Prize
summary: The artist known for her irreverent inflatables gets the Bucksbaum Award; plus, there’s a new grant for artists living with cancer, Murmurs Gallery closes, and more news.

title: Artist’s Planned Monument to Charlie Kirk Gets Trolled Online
summary: “God gave me permission,” Sergio Furnani, the NYC sculptor behind the design, told Hyperallergic about his unsanctioned and widely decried work.

title: Manhattan DA’s Office Returns Three Antiquities to Mexico
summary: The office’s sixth repatriation to the nation included a Nayarit sculpture seized from The Met and an Aztec stone previously possessed by a convicted antiquities trafficker.

title: Required Reading
summary: This week: Chitra Ganesh’s futuristic myths, André Breton and optimism, the mermaids of Florida, a Palestinian digital archive, Argentina and racism, and more.

title: Trump Shrinks Utah National Monuments by 90%
summary: The administration’s cuts to the Grand Staircase-Escalante and Bears Ears national monuments include sacred Indigenous lands and archaeologically rich sites.

title: The Artists Working in Velvet, Amethyst, and Relics
summary: An exhibition showcases works by Sky Hopinka, vanessa german, April Bey, and others that have connections to spiritual practices and rituals.

title: Four Centuries Later, We Still Don't Get Caravaggio
summary: A British docudrama serves as a salutary primer on the Baroque master’s greatest works, but we should be wary of what it tells us about the personality of its subject.

title: The ICA at VCU Brings Immersive Installation "Deo Vindice" to Richmond
summary: The gallery-sized installation at the Institute for Contemporary Art combines Greek mythology with Civil War history to examine white supremacy and hegemonic power.

title: Frederic Edwin Church’s Sublime
summary: Benjamin Moser on a new biography of the Hudson River painter, allegations against Cape Town’s SMAC Gallery, and more.

title: Cape Town Gallery Accused of Withholding Pay and Artworks
summary: An artist who left SMAC Gallery late last year took to social media with claims of delayed payments and missing works.

title: Beer With a Painter: Keltie Ferris
summary: “I am playing with the building blocks of painting,” the artist told me at his studio in Woodstock, where he experiments with gestural compositions and monumental body prints.

title: Remembering Bruno Lucchesi, Pat Oliphant, and Edward Lucie-Smith
summary: This week, we honor a figurative sculptor, a political cartoonist who revolutionized the form, and a prolific poet and writer.

title: How a Basket Empire Wove the Myth of America
summary: As Longaberger's iconic headquarters sit empty, the baskets survive as artifacts of a national identity that commodified craft and packaged settler colonialism as heritage.

title: Guerrilla London Bus Ads Mock Kylie Jenner’s Meta Glasses Campaign
summary: “Billionaires could fund cures for cancer — so why are they funding glasses for perverts instead?" asked the protest group Everyone Hates Elon.

title: The Many Lives of Frederic Edwin Church
summary: Victoria Johnson’s biography is a nuanced portrait of the artist, whose landscapes conveyed the anxieties of a nation struggling over slavery, war, and disunion.
